events.title: NTPL Seniors Social
events.description:
Looking for a fun and friendly way to spend your morning? Bring your favourite handheld craft, projects, and ideas to this lively weekly gathering of seniors. Share your creativity, swap stories, and make new friends in a warm, welcoming space.

Drop-In!

Ideal for ages 55+
events.excerpt: Join a lively group of seniors for crafting, chatting, and connecting. Bring handheld projects, share stories, and enjoy friendly company.

events.title: Back-to-School: Glow Up Lab
events.description:
Give your school supplies a serious glow up!

Drop by Glow Up Lab and turn your notebooks, binders and pencil cases into something that actually feels like you. We’ll have all the supplies you need (stickers, markers, washi tape, and more) to help you customize your gear and make it stand out. Whether you’re going for aesthetic, bold, minimal, or totally chaotic, this is your space to create.

Bring your school supplies and drop in anytime during the program.

Hang out, get creative, and start the school year with style.

Ideal for ages 10–17.
events.excerpt: Customize your school supplies with fun materials and give them a creative glow up.

events.title: Wormy Wednesday
events.description:
Wormy Wednesday is here in Tottenham! The worms have officially wriggled into town, and they’re hungry for your help! Together, we’ll feed them and watch as they transform scraps into rich, amazing soil that we’ll share with our community.

Every Wednesday, kids can join our hands-on vermicomposting adventure! Using child-friendly tools, they’ll prepare food for the worms, care for the composting bin, and discover the magic of sustainability in action.

To make sure everyone gets a turn, please register your child only once per month.

Ideal for ages 3-10
events.excerpt: Kids feed live worms, learn about composting, and care for the composting bin. Registration required with a limit of once monthly.

events.title: Let’s Play: Chess
events.description:
Come Play Chess at the Library! We provide the boards and you bring the moves. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned player, you’re welcome to drop in, meet other players, and enjoy a game. Exchange ideas and information, learn tips and tricks, and play with, other participants.

No registration required, All ages and skill levels welcome.
events.excerpt: Let’s Play Chess! Exchange ideas and information, learn tips and tricks, and play with, other participants. All ages welcome.

events.title: End-of-Summer Treasure Party!
events.description:
RAINY WEATHER UPDATE
Wednesday, September 2
Kate Aitken Hall,  Beeton Community Park,
72 Prospect St., Beeton
See below for times

Ahoy, mateys! Thank you so much for your patience while we worked out an alternative plan for our End-of-Summer Treasure Party this evening due to the forecasted weather.

To keep everyone safe and dry, we are moving the celebration indoors at the Kate Aitken Hall at the Beeton Community Park and switching our foam party to a Magic Show! 🪄🔮

📌Because our indoor space has a smaller capacity, we will be dividing our registered guests into two separate showtimes. Please check the first letter of the email address you used to register and arrive at the time listed below:

🏴‍☠️EMAIL ADDRESSES BEGINNING WITH A–J
Please arrive at 5:00 PM
Pizza and seating: 5:00–5:30 PM
Magic Show: 5:30–6:00 PM

🏴‍☠️EMAIL ADDRESSES BEGINNING WITH K–Z
Please arrive at 6:15 PM
Pizza and seating: 6:15–6:30 PM
Magic Show: 6:30–7:00 PM (Due to limited parking (and magic show spoilers) please do not arrive any earlier than 6:15 PM)

Please DO NOT arrive for the original (5:30 PM) start time. It is very important that you attend the time assigned to your email group so that we can safely accommodate everyone indoors😉

We know this is a last-minute change, and we really appreciate your flexibility and understanding.

If you have any questions, please, email child-youthservices@ntpl.ca. We will be monitoring our inbox throughout the afternoon and will respond as promptly as possible!

Thank you again, and we can’t wait to see you tonight to celebrate such a fantastic summer of reading!🤩📚🍕

Amanda and Leah
events.excerpt: Registration required! Celebrate Summer Reading achievements with pizza, foam party, and more pirate fun!
